long_biography.plain_text:
Conter began riding as a child but concluded that a competitive career would not sustain him. After university he started brokering sport horses in Italy in 1986, then developed Stephex Stables into an international trading, breeding and show-jumping operation. Olympic success brought the stable wider recognition.

His interest in transport led from commissioning individual horseboxes to acquiring manufacturers and building the STX, AKX and Ketterer vehicle brands. Stephex expanded into motorhomes, finance and major equestrian events while retaining horse sport as its organising idea. Conter remains founder and chief executive, overseeing a group with hundreds of employees and a worldwide presence.
